### 1 — The post-replacement freeze (honest outcome: `blocked`)

`freeze_post_replacement` applies W1's typed exclusions — the
`hh-reproof-packet/1` `exclude:runner_infeasible:oracle_fails_on_O{…}`
verdicts (and the `flaky` sub-reason), plus the SELECT-time
`excluded_if_drawn_and_replaced` download declarations — to R6.30's
committed within-cell seeded orders (`task-selection/1`), with
REQ-XH-127(c)'s adjacent-cell dev replacement and its disclosure. The
dev medium cell's committed order is one physical donor pool — a
member serves exactly one slot.

**The committed W1 register records all 20 re-proofed tasks
discordant `o_fail`** — the O surface (Harbor oracle through the local
podman environment) failed on every trial with a Harbor exception
(`podman-compose --in-pod=false` unrecognized by the pinned
podman-compose 1.0.3-3 — a machinery failure, digests recorded
verbatim). The register is the contract's authoritative evidence, the
freeze reads it verbatim, and it is **never** treated as agreement
data: the packet's `reproof.honesty` member says so explicitly.

Applying the committed rules:

- Every drawn task in both lists carries `o_fail` → each slot's
  committed order walks to its next member.
- The only re-proofed members (successors `fix-git`, `tune-mjcf`,
  `password-recovery`, plus already-drawn `raman-fitting`) are also
  `o_fail` — they consume and pass.
- Every next member was **not re-proofed in W1** — no verdict exists.
  The freeze never invents an admit: each slot records the typed state
  `blocked{un_reproofed_successor}` naming the member (`needs:
  wc_reproof` — REQ-XH-116: a successor beyond those re-proofed in W1
  needs the contingency window).
- Dev easy/hard cells whose own orders exhausted fall to the medium
  dev cell's committed order with `disclosure:
  req_xh_127_c_adjacent_cell` (REQ-XH-127(c)).
- The dev medium cell's pool exhausts on its 4th drawn task →
  `blocked{no_adjacent_donor}` — REQ-XH-127(c) maps easy|hard → medium
  only; the emptied medium cell has no declared donor (R6.29's
  recorded reading in `holds.rs`, CC1 — the mapping is not
  duplicated).

**Result: `task_lists.state: "blocked"`** — the honest state, not a
silently substituted list. Full walk (17 slots: 10 held-out + 7 dev,
14 `un_reproofed_successor`, 3 `no_adjacent_donor`, 2 disclosures) is
in the packet's `task_lists` member; resolution is Wc's repair
re-proof (the O-surface machinery repair + re-proof of the needed
successors — the same committed rules then produce the frozen list).
